description: Read a job's durable items, worker/fence/retry state, task links and attempt counts; filters apply before pagination and raw inputs are omitted
name: rag_job_items

description: Read a job's durable attempt history, optionally for one item; includes provider-run IDs and validation/outcome state without raw provider output
name: rag_job_attempts

description: Discover migration workflows by exact subject ID or canonical concept label, including successor membership. Homonymous concepts remain separate. Use returned workflow_id with rag_task_list(workflow)
name: rag_workflow_list

description: Inspect the configured objective, effective system prompt, response schema and hashes without library access or provider calls
name: rag_config_prompt

description: Read bounded library status
name: rag_library_status

description: Read deterministic corpus scope and health without writes, narrative refresh or provider calls
name: rag_library_overview

description: Read the selected profile vocabulary, including permitted concept and relationship types
name: rag_profile_show

description: Report deterministic generation-bound corpus, graph, vector, provenance and maintenance health; optional refresh makes one configured advisory-provider call and caches only citation-validated output
name: rag_library_report

description: Read immutable historic observation points and deterministic deltas without provider calls
name: rag_library_trend

description: List sources with cursor-bounded records
name: rag_source_list

description: Resolve a stable citation to immutable source text and provenance. Large spans are paged; follow next_cursor on the same citation until empty. Cursor counts Unicode characters; citation offsets remain UTF-8 bytes
name: rag_citation_show

description: List configured recurring operation definitions; recurrence and invocation remain externally owned
name: rag_schedule_list

description: Show one configured recurring operation definition without invoking it
name: rag_schedule_show

description: Search and return typed evidence; records durable gap signals and configured auto or hybrid mode may call an embedding provider
name: rag_query_search

description: Return an LLM-ready typed evidence packet and record durable gap signals; configured auto or hybrid mode may call an embedding provider
name: rag_query_evidence

description: Default for ordinary MCP Q&A: read lexical source passages and typed graph evidence without writes or provider calls; decode evidence_json, resolve citations with rag_citation_show, and compose the answer yourself. Use focused searches when a broad question returns no passages
name: rag_query_inspect

description: Use only when the user explicitly requests using or testing the crexxrag answerer. Return evidence and an optional provider-generated, citation-validated answer; adds separate model generation latency and provider usage, and records durable gap signals. For ordinary Q&A use rag_query_inspect and compose the answer yourself; configured provider or budget alone is not a request to use this tool
name: rag_query_answer

description: Return the bounded query trace and record durable gap signals; configured auto or hybrid mode may call an embedding provider
name: rag_query_trace

description: Return bounded typed paths and record durable gap signals; configured auto or hybrid mode may call an embedding provider
name: rag_query_path

description: Return a bounded evidence timeline and record durable gap signals; configured auto or hybrid mode may call an embedding provider
name: rag_query_timeline

description: Read actual item totals by operation and immutable input source. Deferred items are separate from runnable queued items; attempts and corpus coverage have different denominators
name: rag_job_progress

description: Read consistent job item counts, separate limits, worker recovery, recorded usage and interval throughput. Defaults to the last 300 seconds
name: rag_job_status

description: Discover durable jobs with their creation and update times; page all results to select the latest job
name: rag_job_list

description: Read exact retained plan text in bounded Unicode-character pages; concatenate text using next_cursor
name: rag_job_plan

description: Read durable job events in event order; continue using next_cursor
name: rag_job_events

description: Validate effective configuration and compute split identities without resolving credentials
name: rag_config_check

description: Explain effective operational provider policy with redacted credential references
name: rag_config_explain

description: Classify the effective configuration against the current library snapshot without writes
name: rag_config_diff

description: Read and reconcile one durable maintenance run with cursor pagination
name: rag_maintain_status

description: Inspect one maintenance run, work item, or analysis note with cursor pagination
name: rag_maintain_inspect

description: Discover durable maintenance tasks independently of run IDs. Separate required_capability and escalation reason from priority, task state and failures. Use subject for an exact subject ID or concept for an exact canonical label plus related workflows; retain separate homonyms. Page until next_cursor is empty
name: rag_task_list

description: Read a page of a task durable evidence packet with original source text, evidence_id and resolvable citations. Use these exact evidence IDs for a resolution; further query results are exploration until bound to a task
name: rag_task_evidence

description: Page source evidence IDs/citations, catalogue concepts or context fields without loading the full packet. scope=current explores present evidence even when a task packet exceeded its limit; scope=stored inspects its frozen packet. Page limits 1..50. Pass the returned generation as expect_generation to reject changes across pages
name: rag_task_evidence_inventory

description: Inspect the exact retained Codex thread and turn without generation, cancellation or library writes. Returns terminal state, known usage, completeness and a digest
name: rag_job_reconcile_inspect

description: Verify bundle and generation invariants
name: rag_library_verify

description: Read redacted provider route diagnostics; Codex allowance inspection may contact its hosted account service
name: rag_provider_diagnostics

description: Make a budgeted provider call using only public synthetic text and validate the returned structure or embedding
name: rag_provider_test

description: Plan a complete evidence refresh into a new external-agent task. Preserves question/workflow/history and supersedes the old task only on apply. Optional per-action ceilings: maximum_bytes 1024..8388608 (default1048576), maximum_concepts 1..1000 (default1000). Never truncates supports; does not change worker configuration or corpus generation. Generic refresh excludes provenance-enrichment tasks
name: rag_task_refresh_plan

description: Plan an external resolution without writes or provider calls. Inspect the task for response_schema, read rag_task_evidence and rag_profile_show, then submit response_json. Returns canonical plan, digest, grounding and affected objects; apply queues mandatory review

response_json.description: JSON object matching the response_schema returned by rag_maintain_inspect(task ID). Use original source quotes and exact evidence_id values from rag_task_evidence.

name: rag_task_resolve_plan

description: Plan flagging a task as requiring advanced reasoning, independently of priority and status. Does not call a provider or change the corpus
name: rag_task_escalate_plan

description: Plan ingestion without writing the library
name: rag_ingest_plan

description: Census and rank bounded catalogue, graph, note, query-gap, embedding and vector maintenance without writing
name: rag_maintain_plan

description: Plan new claims through the normal external proposal validator without writes. Supply exactly one of proposals_ndjson (inline NDJSON, at most 65535 bytes) or input (server-side file path). Apply queues mandatory review; no claims are accepted by planning

input.description: Server-side NDJSON file path; omit when using inline content.

proposals_ndjson.description: Inline crexx-rag.extraction-proposal/1 or /2 NDJSON, external=1; one complete proposal per line. UTF-8 spans must bind both endpoint labels to an existing revision_chunk_id.

name: rag_proposal_plan

description: List review proposals with state; continue using next_cursor
name: rag_review_list

description: Preview a review decision without writing
name: rag_review_decide_preview

description: Freeze a digest-checked zero-write configuration transition plan
name: rag_config_plan

description: Preview one workflow census and the next retirement task without writes, provider calls or unrelated worker work
name: rag_workflow_reconcile_preview

description: Reconcile one workflow using its retained policy and the generation returned by its preview. Enqueues connections or a retirement task; preserves history and requires separate reviewed retirement
name: rag_workflow_reconcile

description: Record a reasoned task waiver after workers and reviews are settled. Retains missing coverage, history and unknown outcomes; explicit retry reopens under existing limits
name: rag_task_waive

description: Record a durable deduplicated task retry request in any state. Execution retains reviewed windows, attempt limits and uncertainty holds
name: rag_task_retry

description: Record a durable item retry request; linked maintenance work retains its task owner
name: rag_job_retry

description: Reobserve and atomically settle the exact digest-reviewed Codex outcome. Requires a paused, drained job. Preserves usage and attempts; completed output is queued for normal validation. Never starts generation
name: rag_job_reconcile_apply

description: Rebuild stored vectors without provider calls. Optional reconcile closes duplicate active links and skips already covered queued embeddings; requires drained workers
name: rag_vector_rebuild

description: Evaluate the deterministic churn matrix and capture only a materially distinct historic observation
name: rag_library_snapshot

description: Pause one durable job
name: rag_job_pause

description: Continue an interrupted job using existing tasks, receipts and limits. Optional named renewal adds an auditable allowance exactly once; minutes sets its maintenance wall-clock period. Prepare commits continuation without launching workers
name: rag_job_continue

description: Resume one durable job
name: rag_job_resume

description: Request cancellation for one job
name: rag_job_cancel

description: Copy one or all terminal dead letters into a new current-config budgeted job while retaining source lineage
name: rag_job_replay

description: Drain one job without taking supervision authority
name: rag_worker_drain

description: Apply an exact reviewed ingestion plan
name: rag_ingest_apply

description: Apply an exact reviewed evidence refresh plan; returns the successor task ID and preserves old evidence/history. No provider calls or corpus-generation change
name: rag_task_refresh_apply

description: Submit the exact external resolution plan for mandatory review; returns review_id. Does not apply the proposed corpus change
name: rag_task_resolve_apply

description: Apply the exact reviewed advanced reasoning flag; stop ordinary worker dispatch for the task
name: rag_task_escalate_apply

description: Apply an exact reviewed maintenance worklist
name: rag_maintain_apply

description: Apply an exact reviewed proposal plan
name: rag_proposal_apply

description: Persist an authorized review decision
name: rag_review_decide

description: Apply an exact reviewed configuration plan for future work with immutable audit history
name: rag_config_apply

description: Inspect the selected policy file, its SHA-256 and validation state without library access or provider calls
name: rag_config_show

description: Validate and atomically update one selected policy setting using the inspected SHA-256; prompt source pairs are switched together
name: rag_config_set

description: Validate and atomically replace the selected policy from an input file; use missing as the expected hash to create a policy
name: rag_config_replace
